name: 法国人才居留卡—欧盟蓝卡
nameEn: France talent residence permit — EU Blue Card
summary: 面向持有合资格高等教育学历或相当经验、法国高技能工作合同并达到薪酬门槛的人士。
summaryEn: For highly qualified workers with an eligible higher-education credential or comparable experience, a French contract and the required salary.

qualification.summary: 须有至少三年高等教育学历，或符合法定条件的同等层级专业经验。
qualification.summaryEn: Requires at least three years of higher education or professional experience qualifying under the statutory alternatives.

jobOffer.summary: 须有达到申请时规定最低期限的法国工作合同。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A French employment contract meeting the minimum duration in force at application is required.

salary.summary: 年薪须达到申请时适用的法国欧盟蓝卡门槛。
salary.summaryEn: Annual pay must meet the French EU Blue Card threshold applicable when applying.

sources.title: Talent residence card — European Blue Card

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
